links.scope:
Owned-screen link input regression; production engine/network are Rust.
Start one release olo-browser on a 1280x800 Agent Screen initially at 2x,
eval its environment, then: THIS_SCRIPT NAME /var/tmp/OWNED/output.
Add --inline for inline spacing; --breaks for semantic br/wbr and carrier-free text.
No website journey acceptance follows from these authored fixtures.

navigation.scope:
Native navigation on an OWN Agent Screen; authored fixtures accept no sites.
Start release olo-browser there, eval olo-screen env, then run NAME OUTPUT_DIR.
Checks canonical redirects, in-document identity/no I/O, history, keyboard focus
and scroll restoration at all native modes/scales. HTTP server is test-only.

Final main integration will exercise the optimized build.

native_cost_context: Other main-worktree compilation was observed during part of this sequential before/after native sample. Idle CPU/wakeups are zero on both. Retained as evidence; no causal latency/speedup claim. A further matched check follows main integration.
simd_revision: Four-pixel packed u32x4 premultiply and compiler-selected interpolation. All 42 final rotated processes have zero compiler context samples, identical scalar/default input and output hashes. See cost-initial and cost-packed artifacts for earlier revisions. Text-only paint is specialized to bypass image bookkeeping; 1000-element scene cost remains 4.5% above 3035b3ff.
